title: Zephyr: drift bound tracking
description: Track oscillator drift bound for Zephyr C. Acceptance: Works with typical TCXO specs.
notes: Implemented bounded Zephyr CCP-7 oscillator drift tracking in the clean link time-sync subsystem. Added portable 128-bit-equivalent multiply/divide arithmetic that works on 32-bit Zephyr targets; canonical ppm/correction/B(h)/holdover helpers; source-class-aware offset-delta estimator; conservative ceil-rounded TCXO error envelope (20ppm typical); exact 5000ppm holdover threshold; source-change baseline reset; monotonic wrap/reboot regression rejection; outlier expiry; saturating bounds; atomic output and nonblocking fail-closed concurrency. Added strict format-v2 generator and focused host/Zephyr test over ccp7_holdover.json plus overflow, INT64_MIN, zero interval, source switch, duplicate timestamp, u64 wrap, maximum envelope, lock contention, and 32-thread snapshot stress. Validation: AppleClang strict C23 + UBSan CTest 1/1 PASS; direct ThreadSanitizer PASS; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 32-bit compile/runtime 1/1 PASS and PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL; Python CCP-7 2/2 PASS; isolated Rust tdma_clock_vectors 2/2 PASS; ruff and diff-check PASS. Hardware PPS paths untouched.
close_reason: Bounded source-aware drift estimator and conservative holdover error envelope implemented and validated on host and 32-bit Zephyr QEMU.
